text:
maria: Hey team — is it possible to add my adult brother to my Redwood benefits? Hes 32, has limited income, and moved in with me 6 months ago. Not on my tax return.

people-ops: Hi Maria :wave: maybe. For adult dependents we need to confirm carrier rules and whether this qualifies as a QLE outside open enrollment. Can you DM required docs instead of posting here?

maria: Sure. What exactly do you need?

eden-hr: Hi! Typical docs: physician letter describing functional limitations, evidence of financial support (recent bank transfers or an affidavit), proof of shared residence (utility bill, lease), and if available an SSDI/SSI award or Social Security correspondence. If theres a court-appointed guardian, thats also acceptable.

people-ops: Also note timing: carriers often allow retroactive effective dates only within 30-60 days of the request and receipt of docs. If this is a new disability or change in status, that can be a QLE; otherwise carrier review determines eligibility. Payroll will be adjusted from carrier effective date and any retro premiums may be pro-rated.

benefits-bot: Reminder: upload docs via Secure Upload (select "Dependent Eligibility") within 30 days: https://redwood.hr/secure-upload :lock:

maria: Got it. Uploading now (no SSNs in thread). Thanks!

people-ops: We received the upload. We'll review and submit to carrier. Expect 7-14 business days for carrier confirmation. If they need anything else well ping you.

maria: Appreciate it :pray:

people-ops: Leaving this thread for record-keeping. Will update once carrier confirms.
